We run a multi\-tenant automotive SaaS platform used every day by dealership staff and consumers across the United States. We're now in the middle of a significant platform evolution: breaking the legacy monolith into domain\-owned microservices, standing up a modern event\-driven backbone on AWS, and building production AI agents that take real action inside dealer workflows.


That work runs on Tech Leads. A Tech Lead at A2Z Sync is the engineering anchor of a product or platform area: the most senior IC on the team, the person who turns architecture decisions into shipped product, runs design reviews, holds the bar on what gets merged, and owns the outcome when services hit production at 2 AM. You are not a manager. You are the technical leader of a small team of engineers (a mix of US\-based and offshore), and the patterns you set become the patterns the team inherits.


What you will own:


Your areas, end to end: multiple product or platform areas with a team of roughly 3\-5 engineers per product across onshore and offshore, covering both the legacy scope still in production and the new services being built or extracted.


Service design and delivery: from design doc through dual\-write rollout, traffic\-splitting, per\-tenant feature flags, and clean cutover. You decide where the monolith seams are: which domain comes out next, what its service boundary is, and how the data comes with it.


Full\-stack application delivery: vertical slices, not layers. Micro\-frontend delivery (independently deployable React/Next.js modules, API/BFF contracts, shared design system), microservices (domain\-owned, event\-driven over EventBridge, independent pipelines), and performance/monitoring (Core Web Vitals, API latency budgets, OpenTelemetry tracing browser to database, CloudWatch dashboards, load baselines before every cutover).
